partition_boundary.analog: I/O cells: data TX driver and RX receiver, clk/clkb forwarded-clock driver and receiver, pad/ESD structure; cells aib_tx_data, aib_rx_data, aib_tx_clk, aib_rx_clk, aib_pad_esd (design/); nets PAD, PADI, CLK_PAD, CLKB_PAD, VDDIO, VSS
partition_boundary.digital: synthesized data path: lane mux, shift redundancy, DDR registers; rtl/aib_datapath.v, driving the analog cells' DIN, OE, PUN, PD, CLK_D, CLKB_D and reading DOUT, CLK_O, CLKB_O

5.analog.gap: SIM leg is a pointer, not a bound of its own (DR-0022): the DDR exchange format is verified by RTL and the DDR timing is graded at T-16, T-19 and T-20. The 45-corner t02_* edge-separation measurements in sim/clock-path/records/20261113T095936Z/ are reported inputs to those rows, not a grade of T-02. A standing gap, not pending work. Tracked in #216

SIM leg is report-only by design (DR-0022): the specification states no clk/clkb crossing requirement, so the 45-corner crossing measurements in sim/clock-path/records/20261113T095936Z/ stay reported evidence of clock-path health rather than a graded claim; the arrangement the row requires is verified by RTL. A standing gap, not pending work. Tracked in #216

SIM leg has no bound of its own (DR-0023): the mux function is verified by RTL, and the remap's added load and delay are measured over the 45-corner PVT-FULL grid in sim/redundancy-mux/records/20261113T160050Z/ and reported into the rows that carry the numbers -- the common added delay into T-20 and the select-dependent delay between the mux's two inputs into T-13. Neither row is graded here and neither bound changes. A standing gap, not pending work. Tracked in #216

channel-model definition, not a block measurable, so not cited as covered; the +/-20 % channel R/C sensitivity its grid column asks for was never run (every record is nominal kr = kc = 1). Tracked in #193
no end-to-end SIM confirmation and no ANALYSIS roll-up; fed by T-19 and T-21, both open. Tracked in #194

Reproduced in layout/pex/records/20261113T130846Z/ and filed upstream as 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#5491; see layout/pex/README.md 'Defect 2'. Extraction itself is clean and cited above. This repo's obligation to submit the committed 45-corner requests and record delta[] once the tool is fixed is tracked in #226

3.disclosure: Clean means no violation of the rules the curated sg13g2 deck evaluates; it is not full sg13g2 DRC signoff. The deck does not transcribe the latch-up rules (LU.a, LU.c, LU.c1, LU.d, LU.d1) or the pad rules (Pad.a1, Pad.aR, Pad.bR, Pad.d, Pad.d1R, Pad.dR, Pad.gR, Pad.jR, Pad.kR; coverage.unmodeled_rules), and has no ESD rules at all. The net-aware NW.b1 is not checked (coverage.unchecked_rules). The nwell-to-nactiv enclosure and spacing rules are skipped (rules_skipped). ESD/pad layers with no deck rule: the passivation opening 9/0 (analog stream, in layers_in_stream_without_rules) and every pad-rule layer outside the curated set. The aib_pad_esd structure and the pad opening are therefore covered only by the generic Activ, GatPoly, well, metal and via rules on their base layers. The native-deck (klayout engine) run was not made. Violation-free here says nothing about latch-up or pad-rule compliance.
